'''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Well, hello there. Come in, there's something I need you to do. An unpleasant situation has arisen. As you know, my little hobby is in demand among the remaining residents of this great city. But here's the trouble, one of the rifles I assembled fell into the wrong hands and ended up in the hands of those who draw their circles around town. Scavs found it in one of the circles and accused me of supplying the creeps with weapons. I don't need that kind of complaint. Do the job, cut through the ranks of these artists. And I'll make sure to find a decent reward. And another thing, try not to harm Scavs. Enough trouble with them as it is.}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 30 of the [[Cultists|group responsible for the marked circles]]

==Rewards==
* [[Mechanic]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.15'''</font>
* Unlocks purchase of [[GP-25 Kostyor 40mm underbarrel grenade launcher]] at [[Mechanic]] LL1
* Unlocks purchase of [[40mm VOG-25 grenade]] at [[Mechanic]] LL1
* Unlocks purchase of [[M203 40mm underbarrel grenade launcher]] at [[Mechanic]] LL1
* Unlocks purchase of [[40x46mm M386 (HE) grenade]] at [[Mechanic]] LL1
{{Quote|Done? Good job, I'll send the reward by courier. See you later.}}

==Failure Dialogue==
{{quote|I told you not to touch Scavs!}}

==Guide==
In this quest you have to kill 30 [[Cultists]]. While the quest is active you must not kill any [[Scavs]] or it fails.

==Trivia==
*This quest was released together with the video [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yjKL_EMsZ-g "Unknown"]
